data.name: HelpText
data.value: Two sources you can ask about: the user manual (which screen to use, how to operate it) and approved rule extracts (what a rule says and why). Answers are generated only from those two; anything neither covers is answered with "not found" — always open the sources below and verify for yourself. This assistant does not query your actual data (stock quantities, document amounts, and the like), and does not remember what you asked.

data.name: QuestionPlaceholder
data.value: For example: which screen shows materials with no movement for a long time?

data.name: LatencyNote
data.value: Inference runs locally; a question takes about a minute. You can cancel at any time while waiting.

data.name: EmptyPrompt
data.value: Type a question and press Send

data.name: RequestFailed
data.value: Something went wrong. Please try again later.

data.name: UnverifiableCitation
data.value: (the model cited a page that was not supplied this time; it cannot be verified — do not rely on this part)

data.name: StageInferFmt
data.value: Model is reading {0} excerpt(s), about {1} characters…

data.name: NotReady
data.value: The inference service is not ready; questions cannot be answered right now.

data.name: ConfirmRebuild
data.value: Rebuild the index? It occupies inference resources while running, slows everyone's questions down, and may take several minutes.

data.name: StreamIncomplete
data.value: The answer was interrupted while streaming. Please try again.

data.name: ModeManualHint
data.value: Answers how the system works, with citations to the user manual.

data.name: ModeDataHint
data.value: Queries operational data and returns a table. Only reports you are already authorised to open are reachable, and the query parameters are shown so you can verify them.

data.name: TruncatedFmt
data.value: Showing the first {0} of {1} rows (open the corresponding report screen for the full set)
